_comment: Scoring + routing thresholds. Founder tunes these. score is 0-100.
_spend_guardrails: FD cost protections. monthly_global_spend_cap_usd = hard ceiling on ALL paid API spend/month (Haiku+serper+MV+hunter+apollo all gate on budget.can_spend against this). At the cap, paid calls are DENIED (factory keeps running on free routes). kill_switch_paid_spend=true = emergency brake, stops ALL paid spend instantly. MTD spend historically ~$1.43, miner-nightly projects ~$60-90/mo for 2 clients, so 100 is protective headroom — raise when scaling clients.
_junk_floor_comment: Doctrine 0b: stay-vs-discard is the QUALITY axis, not completeness. A lead is early-killed ONLY when its COMPANY quality (fit+brief+signals+web-presence, NOT contact data) is below junk_floor — i.e. no positive evidence it's a good target. Conservative: 8 = discard only total-blank leads (zero fit/signal/presence/brief). Raise as cheap junk detectors (dead-site, off-ICP classifier) come online to leak more junk earlier and save more Tier-2 spend.
_nurture_comment: Outreach playbook nurture caps (OUTREACH_PLAYBOOKS.md §6 rule 4). After the cap, the run PARKS.
_verify_comment: Email-verify step (STEP 1.5). verify_ttl_days = never re-verify the same email within this window. allow_catch_all_default = whether a catch_all/risky email passes the READY gate (per-ICP override via clients.icp_config.allow_catch_all). verify.provider_order = SMTP-verifier vendors tried in order, skipping exhausted ones. min_corroborations/small_company_max = Gate A (corroboration) thresholds. always_smtp (per-ICP) forces Gate B.

verify._recovery_reserve_comment: Verify credits reserved for RECOVERY (promote_candidates) that the general new-lead drain can't consume. Recovering an already-FOUND email is higher-ROI than verifying a fresh lead, so it never gets starved: recovery ceiling = night_credit_cap + recovery_reserve.

_pool_floor_comment: Scheduler pool-floor (STEP 1.5): target READY = ready_leads_per_day x ready_pool_days. Below target -> enqueue discovery+enrich to close the gap, within caps. default_ready_leads_per_day used when the ICP has none.
